# Review - PR 260 @ 97eece72c5a76f66cdd039abfee72368d2e8c831

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: 45e61c9d5fc30815a564316b13e69a3d743590a0. Documentation-only change of 804 added and 65 removed lines over 13 files (personas, protocols, telemetry records, one comparison note, two dispatcher regression tests); no Lean, blueprint or runtime source is touched.

## Findings

- [ ] F1 (code; changes) results/telemetry/model-comparison/astra-effort-integration-20260906.md:27-30 - this new file states three rules in the present tense that the same diff supersedes in `local/protocols/issues-prs.md` section 6: "Main remains max; workers ... selecting exactly max or xhigh" (section 6 now reads "Main remains Astra Ultra; routine workers use Sol Ultra"), "The 8-11 useful-worker floor and eleven-worker cap" (section 6: "The September 6 eight-to-eleven allocation is historical; current admission uses the configured account caps in `sessions.md` section 4"), and "All already-posted #26 items, including B7 and B8, await the human owner" (section 6 and `local/personas/main.md:16-22` record the 2026-09-06T05:05Z withdrawal of exactly that hold). The note is not marked historical and `results/telemetry/model-comparison/README.md:28-30` links it as the live post-merge integration note, so a reader lands on the opposite of the governing protocol on the one authority question this PR exists to settle. Fix: add a dated superseded-by header to the note, or rewrite those four sentences as observations as of 2026-09-06 with an explicit pointer to `issues-prs.md` section 6.
- [ ] F2 (code; changes) results/telemetry/events.md:5046,5054-5055 - the authority record for the whole amendment cites `/tmp/qpbt-owner-concurrency-message.txt` with "Source SHA-256 at inspection: 386595c69b2ccd69cb729db1644adeede78db08460c2caad696c25adfcf4b610". That path is outside the repository and its current content hashes to b90b38f3ecd4163145b55ce3de5952c3abd5aa6da838b3aad3eb2eb7d115bae8, so the recorded hash no longer verifies anything a reader can inspect. The same owner decision is already committed on `github/main` at `results/telemetry/owner-messages/qpbt-owner-access-only-20260906-0505.md`, carrying the identical operative statement, the B8 attempts 11/12 tranche and the 25331-second cumulative bound, and the record does not cite it. `local/protocols/meta.md:12-14` requires an amendment to cite its trigger as evidence. Fix: cite `results/telemetry/owner-messages/qpbt-owner-access-only-20260906-0505.md` as the authority in that paragraph, keeping the temp path and its at-inspection hash as a secondary provenance note.
- [ ] F3 (code; minor) results/telemetry/events.md:7888,7924,7932-7935 - the recovery block asserts "Their original paragraphs follow verbatim" and "They are retained verbatim as historical records", but the retained 2026-09-04 operator-takeover entry is not verbatim: at pre-merge `428b11cd` its Handover bullet read "posted its exact in-flight state to / #27 (\"Handover to owner session\") and exited at 2026-09-04T14:57:57Z. The owner session / picks up every lane from that report", whereas at this head line 7934 ends at "posted its exact in-flight state to", line 7935 continues with "picks up every lane from that report", and the missing continuation line sits orphaned at line 7924 directly under the heading. The line-multiset preservation check described at line 7887 cannot see this: the set difference of nonblank lines between `428b11cd` and this head is empty, because that line text also occurs elsewhere in the file. Fix: restore the two dropped words of that bullet in place at line 7934 and delete the stray line 7924, or replace "verbatim" with an accurate description of a line-level reconstruction.

## Review

Scope. Base is `main`; merge base 9b34871a7b8021b17bbf7bbbf451c3816078e376. The worktree HEAD equals the published head 97eece72, so I read the diff and the changed files at that sha. I read every hunk of all 13 changed files in full.

Exact-head CI. `local-ci/summary` is success, "all gating steps passed (283s)", with all eight step contexts green (build, blueprint-render, paper-gaps, blueprint-sync, file-length, proof-debt, proof-evasion, statement-origin), created 2026-09-17T11:26-11:27Z.

Proof integrity. No file under `MIPStarRE/`, `blueprint/` or `references/` is touched, and `AGENTS.md` is unchanged; the diff introduces no `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom` or `native_decide`, and no theorem statement or definition is altered. Nothing in the policy text weakens the faithfulness bar: `issues-prs.md` section 6 keeps correctness, sufficiency, minimality and downstream convergence, adds "Faithfulness is not waived" to the main-authority paragraph, and now requires a definition or game correction to return to main for a separately recorded decision rather than being adopted silently.

Gate direction. The protocol edits tighten rather than relax the gates I checked: `review.md` section 12 makes the four-round ceiling an operator admission rule and states that a script warning or `--force-review` is not permission to exceed it; section 9 confines a post-head-change review to that ceiling; section 13 states that `--force-review` bypasses the fast path and not the cap or any evidence requirement; `sessions.md` section 4.1 states that the tranche does not change the `--continue-from` validator, which still refuses a changed original limit or an exhausted budget.

Authority and arithmetic. I verified the 2026-09-06T05:05Z decision against the copy committed on `github/main` (`results/telemetry/owner-messages/qpbt-owner-access-only-20260906-0505.md`), which is not part of this diff. It authorizes exactly attempts 11 and 12 at at most 2700 seconds each, retaining 10 completed attempts and 19931 working seconds from anchor 2026-09-05T19:24:00Z, with attempt 12 conditional on main's assessment. The PR text matches: 19931 + 5400 = 25331, the cumulative upper bound the owner message states. `github/main`'s `issues-prs.md` does not yet carry the access-only rule, so this PR is its first installation and does not duplicate main.

Earlier rounds. Four marked reviews exist, at df9b555 (CHANGES_REQUESTED, one finding), ecba3e7, 428b11cd and a56b0e95 (all APPROVED, no findings). The only finding raised, F1 on attached short model options in `local/bin/codex-policy-shim.sh`, is addressed: the shim is not in this diff (it comes from main), and the two regression tests this PR adds cover it. I ran both in the PR worktree: `test_runtime_shim_normalizes_attached_config_options` and `test_runtime_shim_validates_attached_model_options` pass in 2.327s. My three findings are new and none re-raises earlier feedback.

Round count. This head is the fifth since the first marked review, and `review.md` section 12, as amended by this very PR, says main must choose a terminal disposition after the fourth full round rather than dispatch a fifth. I raise this as context for main's disposition, not as a defect in the diff: this review is the owner-authorized independent pass of 2026-09-17, not a `review.sh` round, and the head changed after a56b0e95.

Not checked. I did not run the full dispatcher or review-workflow suites, the pre-commit hook, or any build; no Lean elaboration was needed since no Lean file changed. I did not verify the six historical Astra probes or any provider-side effort claim, and I did not re-derive the byte-identity assertions the integration note makes about files copied from primary `9102b74`. All six relative links added or changed by the diff resolve to files that exist at this head.

Prose lane is n/a: the diff touches no blueprint TeX, no `docs/paper-gaps/` note and no mathematical prose, matching how the four earlier rounds classified this PR. The three findings above are documentation-correctness defects in the workflow and telemetry layer and belong to the code lane.

VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED (code=CHANGES_REQUESTED, prose=n/a)
